newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA MOST TRADED OUTSIDE BOURSE WEEK ending MAY 23.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA MOST TRADED OUTSIDE BOURSE WEEK ending MAY 23.

text.p: Trade in shares outside the bourse came to 352,416 lats in the week ending May 23, the latest figures available, compared with 459,470 lats of official trading on the market the same week, the bourse said on Friday.
The most traded stock that week was Valmiera Glassfibre on 98,822 lats, Riga Shipyard came next on 73,760 lats while Unibanka was third at 60,967 lats.
